step1_analysis.circuit_type: Dynamic Current Mode Logic (DyCML) Evaluation Tree
step1_analysis.description: An NMOS differential pair with a clocked tail transistor, forming the evaluation tree of a DyCML gate. It steers the tail current to one of the output branches based on the differential input, enabling high-speed, reduced-swing logic operation without a static current source.

paper_reference.title: Dynamic Current Mode Logic (DyCML): A New Low-Power High-Performance Logic Style

delay.description: Propagation delay from the clock rising edge to the differential output evaluation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Time constant tau = R_load * C_out. With R_load=1k and C_out~10fF, tau=10ps. Delay is approx 0.69*tau + transistor switching time.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 (130nm) is significantly faster than the 0.6um process in the paper. A single gate delay is expected to be in the tens of picoseconds, whereas the paper reports the delay for an entire 16-bit adder.

power.description: Average power consumption of the gate during dynamic operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current I_tail = 0.5 * 270u * (5/0.5) * (0.9-0.42)^2 = 311uA. With 50% clock duty cycle, avg current = 155uA. Power = 1.8V * 155uA = 280uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the tail transistor saturation current with Vgs=0.9V (reduced clock swing) and 50% duty cycle for a single gate.

voltage_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the output nodes.

sky130_expected.reasoning: DyCML relies on reduced voltage swing to save power and increase speed. ~300mV is a typical target for CML-style logic.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure delay, voltage swing, and average power of the DyCML evaluation tree with 1kOhm resistive loads and a 500MHz clock.
step3_testbench.spice:
* DyCML Evaluation Tree Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 N2 LABEL_NET_0 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 LABEL_NET_1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

VDD VDD 0 1.8
R1 VDD N2 1k
R2 VDD N3 1k

* Clock signal on tail (500 MHz, 0.9V reduced swing)
VCLK LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(0 0.9 0 50p 50p 0.95n 2n)

* Differential inputs
VINP LABEL_NET_0 0 PULSE(1.5 1.8 0.2n 50p 50p 2n 4n)
VINN LABEL_NET_1 0 PULSE(1.8 1.5 0.2n 50p 50p 2n 4n)

.control
tran 10p 8n

* Measure voltage swing
meas tran vout_max MAX v(n3) FROM=3.5n TO=5n
meas tran vout_min MIN v(n3) FROM=3.5n TO=5n
let swing = vout_max - vout_min
print swing

* Measure delay (CLK to OUT)
* CLK rises at 4ns, N3 evaluates low. Thresholds: CLK 50% (0.45V), OUT 50% (~1.65V)
meas tran t_delay TRIG v(LABEL_NET_2) VAL=0.45 RISE=1 FROM=3.5n TARG v(n3) VAL=1.65 FALL=1 FROM=3.5n
print t_delay

* Measure power
meas tran avg_current AVG i(VDD) FROM=0 TO=8n
let avg_power = -avg_current * 1.8
print avg_power

quit
.endc
